limitations: Snapshot reads outcomes and events sequentially; an outcome vector may precede its complete event. Remaining estimate conservatively includes that in-flight vector.
Only completed vector event durations are used, not differences between episode timestamps.
Later tasks, episode lengths and resource conditions may differ; estimate is conditional.
Epoch compute excludes saves, preparation and collection; cross-seed speed differences do not identify causal optimization gain.
Independent final CPU acceptance, analysis and publication remain additional.
